rows: My technique is not a rumour. Watch me use it on people who think they are better.
I hit as hard as anyone on this card, and I have never once apologised for it.
Take a risk tonight and I will make you pay for it. That is the deal.
Slow it down if you like. I will still be the one setting the pace.
The people paid to see work. Give them work, not a warm-up.
The people here deserve a short answer. I am better than you.
I belong among the strongest in this circuit. Tonight I will prove it again.
Look at my shoulders, then look at my face. Neither one is asking for help.
You talk about technique. Show me one real hold in there and I will believe you.
You want a brawl? Bring your best strikes and I will bring mine.
Risk is not the same as ability. I have seen plenty of people take risks and fall off.
A slow pace will not save you. I will still be standing at the end of it.
The people deserve better than talk. I respect that you want work, and so do I.
You claim to be among the best. Let me see whether the claim survives the first minute.
You are proud of your {strength}. Good. Proud people make mistakes against a plan.
Your {strength} will be tested tonight, and I will be the one doing the testing.
You are professional about this, and I respect it. Now prove it under pressure.
Fair. You said what you meant, so I will do the same.
I could tell you what I think of that. I would rather show you in the ring.
One fall, no excuses. Think you can keep me down for three seconds?
On the mat I will find your weak point. Then I will stay there.
Grounded or standing, you will not find a comfortable place with me.
Stay in front of me if you dare. I want to see how long you last.
Good answer. Now let us see whether the match matches it.
You heard me. Now give me an answer, not a shrug.
Fair enough. We both know what the bell is for.
I can accept that. We both know what the bell is for.
I came here to win, and I am going to fight for it.
I am coming for the win, and I will take it honestly.
Whatever happens, you will know exactly where you stood with me.
It is done with me. Let us get on with it.
I have a plan, and it does not involve you talking any more.
